findings.message: The param listaId selects formularioLista but no request fetches the record; added the public selectFormularioLista(id | null) and the getter formularioLista (row of the loaded listas by id). Selecting also fills salvarListaDraft; an unresolved id publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarListasError.
buscarListas takes a name fragment but no state holds it; added the state busca (published by buscarListas) so the search field can show the current filter.

criarLista and salvarLista have no <command>.input state; added criarListaDraft and salvarListaDraft with setCriarListaDraft and setSalvarListaDraft. The edit draft is prefilled from the selected row and refilled from the returned lista after salvarLista.

The list is ordered by nome by the backend, but criarLista output is appended to listas (no sorting in the browser), so a new list may be out of order; it may also not match an active busca filter. A reload (listarListas/buscarListas) restores the order.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
